What We Do

Specialist services,
exceptional results

01

Microcement & Decorative Surfaces

Seamless microcement floors, walls, benchtops and feature surfaces. A beautiful, hard-wearing finish for bathrooms, kitchens and living spaces — expertly prepared and applied.

Bathrooms Floors Benchtops Feature Walls
02

Interior & Exterior Painting

Skilled interior and exterior painting for homes and businesses. Feature colours, clean lines and thorough surface preparation — Level 4–5 finishes done properly.

Residential Commercial Dulux Partner All Substrates
03

Full Bathroom Renovations

End-to-end bathroom transformations — demolition, waterproofing, substrate prep, tiling, fixtures and finishing. One team, start to finish, done to a high standard.

Waterproofing Plasterboard Villaboard Full Fit-Out
04

Property Maintenance

Ongoing maintenance contracts for landlords, agencies and strata. Repaints, repairs, pressure cleaning, minor carpentry and pre-lease make-good.

Landlords Strata Make-Good Contracts
05

Renovation & Fitouts

Full interior renovations — kitchens, living spaces, offices. Plasterboard, feature walls, cabinetry painting, floor levelling and surface finishing.

Kitchens Offices Floor Levelling Fitouts
06

Roofing & Roof Painting

Roof inspections, repairs, pointing, repointing and full roof repaints. Colorbond colour consultation, protective coatings and leak investigations.

Repainting Repairs Pointing Colorbond
07

Handyman & Repairs

The all-rounder service — lock changes, door adjustments, flat-pack assembly, shelving, picture hanging, minor plumbing and carpentry. If it needs fixing, we handle it.

Locks Assembly Fixtures Odd Jobs

Why Perth Multiservices

Craft over
compromise

After 20 years in the trade — learning our craft in France, where attention to detail is everything — we brought that same care to Perth. For us, this work is a genuine passion long before it's a job. That's why we put real thought into every surface: we do it because we love it, never just to get it done. We treat every home like our own, and we're not happy until you are.

✓

Fixed-price quotes, no surprises

All quotes are lump-sum and itemised. What we quote is what you pay.

✓

Skilled across every trade we offer

Two decades of hands-on experience in painting, microcement, renovation and repairs — real expertise you can see in the finish.

✓

Microcement done right

Careful substrate prep and a proper application process for a smooth, durable microcement finish that lasts.

✓

White Card & construction site ready

We work comfortably across residential, commercial and active construction sites.

✦

Driven by passion, not obligation

This is a craft we genuinely love — that's why the care shows in every finish, on every job, big or small.

✦

AI-powered project visualisation

We use AI tools to bring your ideas to life before we start — see your finished room, colours and finishes rendered in advance, so you can commit to big projects with confidence.

How It Works

Simple process,
seamless experience

1

Free Quote

Contact us and we'll arrange a site visit or video assessment. You receive a detailed, fixed-price quote within 48 hours.

2

Planning

We confirm materials, timeline and access. You choose finishes and colours with our guidance. No hidden decisions later.

3

Execution

Our team works methodically and tidily. We keep you informed at each stage and flag anything unexpected immediately.

4

Handover

Final walkthrough, snag list cleared, and your space is ready. We're available after completion for any questions.
